package.name: amiga_can
package.description: ROS Noetic bridge between the TAD-Policy / NoMaD-RED navigation policy and the Farm-ng Amiga CAN bus via a Peak PCAN-USB adapter (SocketCAN). Provides a heartbeat Twist-to-CAN bridge, CAN sniffer, keyboard teleop, and joystick teleop. Tested on Jetson AGX Orin + JetPack 5.x.
